init.title: SmartLists – settings for everyone
init.description:
All settings – lists, stores, categories, sharing, devices, extras and more – are on the SmartLists page under ⚙ Settings: [➜ Open settings]({url})

Personal differences are set by every user there under *For me*.

menu_options.restart: Run setup again / start from scratch

naming.title: Naming convention
naming.description: A character in front of a word turns it into a badge, e.g. “Milk @REWE” → store badge REWE. Characters stay in the item name. “—” turns a kind off.

controls.title: Controls – default for everyone
controls.description: Applies to every user who hasn't set their own in the card.

data.row_buttons: Show pencil and bin in each row
data.shop_tap_row: Shopping mode: tap whole row to check

app_lists.title: Lists from the app

packs.title: Category detection – keyword packs
packs.description:
Active packs, in order of precedence: {order}

⭐ = built-in (changes go into an add-on pack “+”), ✏️ = custom. The same is available in the SmartLists card or sidebar page → ⚙ → Household.

pack_import.title: Paste pack as JSON
pack_import.description: Format: {example} – or the app's category_pack_v2.json. The same name replaces an existing custom pack.

pack_edit.title: Edit {name}
pack_edit.description:
{hint} {count} keywords. Examples: {sample}

Add: one or more keywords (separated by commas or new lines), all get the chosen category. Remove: only your own keywords (for built-in packs: your additions).

overview.title: All SmartLists lists

restart.title: Run setup again
restart.description: Choose what to reset first – to-do lists and their items are never deleted. Afterwards the setup assistant opens via a link (and the next time an admin opens SmartLists).

data_description.settings: Naming convention, badges and colours, stores and zones, aisle orders, permissions, voice and automations, list display, controls for everyone, keyword packs.
data_description.data: Remembered categories, history and statistics, prices and expenses, templates and meal plan.
data_description.combined: Only the combined view – the source lists stay unchanged.

assistant.title: Setup assistant
assistant.description:
[➜ Open the setup assistant]({url})

It opens on the SmartLists page and guides you through lists, stores, notation, language, people and extras. Nothing is reset. To reset parts first, use “Run setup again / start from scratch”.

restart_done.title: Reset done
restart_done.description: Done. [➜ Open the setup assistant now]({url}) – it also appears the next time an admin opens the SmartLists page or card.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description:
[➜ Open the settings on the SmartLists page]({url})

There you find everything in one place, with search: *For me*, *Global* (admins), *Insights* and – in the gear of each list – the settings of that list.

get_items.name: Get items
get_items.description: Open items of one or all lists, filtered by store, person, tag or category (with response, e.g. for notifications).

add_due_items.name: Add due items
add_due_items.description: Adds due items now to the list chosen under “Voice & automations”.

add_template.name: Add template
add_template.description: Adds all items of a template (e.g. “Pancakes”) to a list – quantities scaled to the servings; items already on the list get their quantity increased.

template.name: Template
template.description: Name or ID of the template.

missing_source.title: Combined list “{list}” is missing a source list
missing_source.description:
The combined list **{list}** refers to to-do lists that no longer exist: {sources}.

Edit the list under Settings → Devices & services → SmartLists (⋮ → Reconfigure) and remove or replace them.

stale_device.title: Device “{device}” has not synced for {days} days
stale_device.description: The HA SmartLists app on **{device}** has not synced for {days} days. If the device is no longer used, remove it under SmartLists → Configure → Connected devices and delete its token in the profile. If it is still used, open the app once to sync.

unmigrated_list.title: App list “{list}” is not yet in SmartLists

confirm.title: Take over “{list}” into SmartLists
confirm.description:
**{entity_id}** is a list of the HA SmartLists app that is not yet a SmartLists list. Taking it over creates the own list **{title}** with all items, notes and checkmarks; the owner can share it with others.

The old list stays unchanged – delete it yourself later if you no longer need it. Combined lists that use it keep using the old list.
